score_calculation: float64 dot product of saved float32 query/product vectors, np.einsum with optimize=False; no renormalization, encoding or full-catalog float64 search
pairing: missing exact members versus ANN-only members; match identical float32 vector bytes first with ID ties, then maximum-cardinality score-equivalent pairs by ascending float64 score/ID and two-pointer matching, then pair remaining members by descending score/ascending ID
adjusted_agreement: strict overlap plus identical-vector and score-equivalent pair credits, divided by 100; diagnostic only, never substitute it into the prior adoption rule
depth_context: count primary missing members also absent from saved hnsw-128 and hnsw-256 lists; no new search depth or graph construction
labels: preserve human E/S/C/I and unknown; count new/lost known Exact products separately in dense and hybrid lists, by locale and category
cases: up to one largest strict-score-loss count, one greatest negative hybrid recall delta, and one largest identical-vector count per locale; require a positive count/negative delta; break ties by query_id; merge overlapping cases, include at most two pairs per case
repeat: fresh diagnostic runs must reproduce all per-query, pair and case artifacts plus aggregates; sources, saved results and index bytes must remain unchanged
scope: diagnostic only; no ANN parameter changes, new retrieval, training, encoding, new labels, int8, serving or official test access
